[id="adding-a-hugging-face-catalog-source_{context}"]
= Add a Hugging Face organization as a model catalog source

[role='_abstract']
You can add a Hugging Face organization as a model catalog source to make publicly available models from that organization discoverable in the model catalog.
Each Hugging Face source connects to a single organization and retrieves its public, non-gated models.

.Prerequisites

* {productname-long} version 3.3 or later is installed.
* You are logged in to {productname-long}.
* You have the Cluster Admin or {productname-short} Admin role.
* Your cluster has network connectivity to huggingface.co.

.Procedure

. Identify the correct organization name for the Hugging Face organization that you want to add.
+
The organization name must be the case-sensitive URL slug from the Hugging Face website, not the display name.
To find the correct name, go to the organization's page on huggingface.co and note the path segment in the URL.
+
For example, for the organization at `huggingface.co/meta-llama`, the correct organization name is `meta-llama`, not the display name "Meta Llama".

. From the {productname-short} dashboard, click *Settings* -> *AI Catalog Settings*.
. Click *Add catalog source*.
. In the *Source name* field, enter a descriptive name for the catalog source.
. In the *Source type* list, select *Hugging Face*.
. In the *Allowed organization* field, enter the case-sensitive URL slug for the Hugging Face organization.
+
[IMPORTANT]
====
The organization name is case-sensitive and must match the URL slug exactly.
Using the display name or the wrong case causes the source to return no models.
====
. Optional: Configure include or exclude filters to control which models from this organization appear in the catalog.
+
For Hugging Face sources, use only the model name without an organization prefix.
For example, use `Llama-3.1-8B`, not `meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B`.
+
For more information, see xref:configuring-model-catalog-source-filters_{context}[Configure include and exclude filters for model catalog sources].
. Optional: In the *Labels* field, enter labels for the catalog source.
. Click *Save*.

.Limitations

* Each Hugging Face source is limited to one organization.
To add models from multiple Hugging Face organizations, create a separate source for each organization.
* Only public, non-gated models are supported for catalog-based deployment.
Private and gated Hugging Face model support is planned for a future release.

[IMPORTANT]
====
In disconnected (air-gapped) environments, Hugging Face sources are not available because they require network connectivity to huggingface.co.
Use YAML-file sources instead.
====

.Verification

. From the {productname-short} dashboard, click *Settings* -> *AI Catalog Settings*.
. Next to the Hugging Face source that you added, click *Preview* to verify that the expected models appear.
. From the {productname-short} dashboard, click *AI hub* -> *Catalog* and verify that the models from the Hugging Face organization are displayed.
+
Changes might take a few minutes to appear because catalog sources require syncing model metadata from external services.

[NOTE]
====
If the source creation fails or no models appear after saving, verify that the organization name is correct and that your cluster has network connectivity to huggingface.co.
For more information, see xref:troubleshooting-model-catalog-access_{context}[Troubleshooting model catalog access issues].
====
